verdict.rationale: Version-control friendliness is a fair question for any game engine, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents text-based or diffable scene formats, merge tooling, VCS integration, or built-in multi-user collaboration. The items on hidden imported-resource folders, external text editors, plugins and the CLI are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a studio lead, the project format and tooling play well with version control and multi-person teams — mergeable scenes, diffable text formats, or built-in collaboration
